item: Video must be 30 seconds or longer
Vertical format (9:16)
English voiceover preferred
English subtitles are required
Brand name must be spelled accurately: RUACH VOCAL
Product name must be spelled accurately: RUACH VOCAL One-Day Package
Need to show arriving at the studio and first impression of the space
Need to show real moments from the lesson with the coach in a fun and engaging way
Need to show singing or warming up before the lesson
Need to show singing or vocal difference after the lesson
Need to show or mention the recording / before-and-after process if possible
Need to mention that coaches communicate comfortably in both English and Korean
Need to mention Ruach Vocal is located between Hongdae and Hapjeong
Need to mention the free trial lesson event and encourage viewers to apply
Need to mention coaches speak both English and Korean (great for foreigners in Korea)
Need to mention Ruach Vocal is hosting an open mic within the next 3 months
Need to share honest personal experience of vocal difference after the lesson (if genuinely felt)
Do not make exaggerated or unrealistic claims — keep review honest and natural
Hook (1-3 sec): Need to open with a strong hook — before/after clip or relatable foreigner-in-Korea intro
Main: Need to show lesson process naturally — arriving / meeting coach / singing / feedback / English communication
Outro: Need to end with honest thoughts and mention the free trial lesson event as CTA
Need to tag @ruachvocalmethod on Instagram / TikTok
Need to include hashtag #ruachvocal
Need to include hashtag #voicelessonsinseoul
Need to include hashtag #singinglessonsinseoul
Need to include hashtag #vocaltrainingseoul
Need to include hashtag #openmicinseoul
Do not leave out the free trial lesson event
Do not skip showing the actual lesson experience with the coach
Do not omit that English communication with coaches is comfortable and natural
Do not make exaggerated claims that were not genuinely experienced
